final.paper_results: No per-tissue DEG counts in text. 'top 500 DEGs from each tissue (the average number of DEGs in a tissue)' (S2.9.p3); BAT has the most DEGs (S2.8.p1); liver and heart fewer DEGs than muscle and gWAT (S2.6.p1, S2.7.p1); Slc25a1, Acly, Ccn1 and Dusp1 DE in all tissues except liver (S2.9.p1).

caveats: The paper gives no per-tissue DEG count in the text (figures S11A/S12A only): only an average of ~500 DEGs per tissue, BAT the most, liver and heart fewer.
The paper's batch and flow-cell lane adjustment cannot be reproduced.
The GEO deposit has 50 strains x 1 animal per arm per tissue; the paper describes 100 strains.

Direction conflict: the paper reports liver DEGs enriched for mitosis/cell cycle and argues for hepatocyte proliferation after training (S2.6.p1, S3.p4); in our strain-blocked model HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT is DOWN in TRN (NES -1.57, FDR 0.011), E2F targets trend down (NES -1.35, FDR 0.077), and Mki67 is not DE (log2FC -0.12, padj 0.69).

reasoning: The paper's estimand and method are reproduced on the deposited data with declared deviations (no batch/lane, strain blocking).
